Midnight.Description: Dark grey. Easy on the eyes for long sessions.

Christmas.Description: Seasonal. Deep green with red and gold.

Slate.Description: Neutral blue-grey. Calm and low-contrast for long sessions.

Nordic.Description: Cool arctic palette. Soft contrast, easy on tired eyes.

Solarized.Description: The classic Solarized dark palette. Warm and readable.

Graphite.Description: Near-black with amber accents. Minimal and sharp.

Forest.Description: Mid green. Distinct from the blues without going dark.

Plum.Description: Muted purple. Useful when several consoles are open at once.

Daylight.Description: Light theme. For bright rooms and projectors.

Contrast.Description: Maximum contrast. Accessibility and difficult screens.

Sapphire.Description: Deep corporate navy. The classic dark blue admin console.

Burgundy.Description: Muted wine red. Warm without being loud.

Teal.Description: Blue-green. Reads as calm rather than corporate.

Copper.Description: Warm rust. Stands out sharply beside any blue.

Indigo.Description: Deep blue-violet. Darker and cooler than the default blue.

Steel.Description: Mid blue-grey. Lighter than Slate, still a dark theme.

Ocean.Description: Deep blue-teal. Cooler and quieter than the default blue.

Cobalt.Description: Vivid blue. Brighter and more saturated than the default.

Olive.Description: Muted green-brown. Low saturation, easy for long sessions.

Mocha.Description: Warm dark brown. Softer than a pure grey at night.

Sandstone.Description: Warm light theme. Softer than Daylight under bright light.

Console 2.Description: Light. The Admin Console 2 palette: neutral grey, white cards, blue accent.

Console 2 Dark.Description: Dark. The Admin Console 2 palette at night: slate surfaces, brighter blue accent.

Mist.Description: Muted light blue-grey. The calmer of the two.

Powder.Description: Muted light blue. Slightly bluer and lighter than Mist.

Sapphire Light.Description: Sapphire, lifted. Noticeably lighter, contrast still strong.

Sapphire Bright.Description: Sapphire, lifted further. The lightest that stays comfortably readable.

Navy.Description: Dark. Deep navy with a lighter blue accent and a vertical gradient.
